blocks.code:
<?php
$x = 5;   // global

function test() {
    echo $x;   // Warning : Undefined !
}

function testGlobal() {
    global $x;
    echo $x;   // 5
}

function counter() {
    static $n = 0;
    return ++$n;
}
echo counter(); // 1
echo counter(); // 2
